خَطَلٌ inf. n. of 1 [q. v.]. (S, Msb, &c.) ―
-b2- A twisting of one's self, and walking with an elegant and a proud and self-conceited gait, with an affected inclining of the body from side to side (K. [See 5.]) ―
-b3- Corrupt speech: or loquacity: (TA:) or corrupt and conflicting speech: (S, O:) or corrupt speech with loquacity. (K.) In a woman, Foul, or obscene, speech; and conduct that induces doubt, or suspicion, or evil opinion. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
